title: Growth ratchet on the TD controller, frozen top-level module list, and three project skills for structural work
context: The owner raised maintainability and separation of concerns as projects grow and offered a generic seven-skill coding micro-skills pack for consideration. Assessment: four of the pack's skills (bug-fix, test-and-validate, implement-feature, refactor) duplicate already-installed process skills and would create competing instructions; the real structural risk is src/td-tab.js at 17,630 lines (34% of 51,919 source lines) with only src/core, src/domain and src/content under mechanical dependency guards.
outcome: npm run architecture now reads docs/architecture-budget.json: lineBudgets pins src/td-tab.js at 17,630 lines and fails on growth, printing a lower-the-budget hint when the file shrinks; topLevelModules freezes the 100 existing src/*.js files so a new top-level module fails and new code must go into a layer directory. Three project-local skills were adopted under .claude/skills/: add-module, remove-dead-code and architecture-review, each adapted to the Stalheart layers and the ratchet. Each skill was baseline-tested with a read-only planning scenario before writing: the add-module baseline skipped the owner search and planned a hookup that grows the controller; the architecture-review baseline missed the 92-line controller growth in ae88ea2 and the existing src/domain/manual-weapon.js beside the new pilot aiming; the remove-dead-code baseline called two actively imported compatibility facades safe to delete without classifying them. Verification runs with the skills present addressed those gaps. Documented in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and AGENTS.md.
alternatives: Install all seven pack skills verbatim: rejected, overlapping and sometimes contradicting installed TDD/debugging/verification skills; the files also lack skill frontmatter and would not register.
Rely on prose rules alone without the ratchet: rejected, two thirds of the source sits outside the enforced layers so advice has nothing to check against.
Auto-lower the budget on every run: deferred; a hint keeps the budget change an explicit reviewed edit.
evidence: node test/architecture.mjs: new assertions for line budgets and top-level placement pass
node scripts/architecture.mjs with a probe line appended to src/td-tab.js and a stray src/zz-probe.js: both failures reported, exit 1; restored tree passes
npm run check passes with the budget file in place
